.. change::
    :tags: feature, autogenerate
    :tickets: 1867

    Added :meth:`.Rewriter.scope`, a context manager that provides a
    temporary registration scope for a :class:`.Rewriter`.  Rewrite rules
    registered within the scope override those registered normally, and
    the original rules are restored when the scope is exited, including
    when an exception is raised.  Nested scopes are restored in LIFO order.
    The scope is local to the :class:`.Rewriter` instance, so rewrite
    rules registered within it are not visible to other
    :class:`.Rewriter` instances.

    Additionally, the processed-marker that :class:`.Rewriter` uses to
    avoid processing the same directive more than once is now scoped to a
    single invocation, so that a second traversal of the same operation
    tree will still apply the current rewrite rules rather than being
    skipped.
